categories.main_business_segments: Wangsu Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in Content Delivery Network (CDN) and edge computing, cloud security, computing cloud services, managed service provider (MSP) offerings, green data centers including IDC and liquid cooling solutions, and equipment sales and software development. The company focuses on providing IT infrastructure services such as network acceleration, security, and edge computing platforms to internet, government, and enterprise customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced CDN technologies, edge computing platforms (ECP) integrating computing, storage, and network capabilities, cloud security solutions including DDoS defense, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and zero-trust architectures. It also develops liquid cooling technologies for energy-efficient data centers and offers cloud computing services based on GPU and CPU cloud resources, containerization, and serverless architectures. R&D emphasizes AI integration, serverless computing, and intelligent security.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Wangsu serves a broad range of industries including video streaming, e-commerce, gaming, government, finance, automotive, retail, media, consumer electronics, education, and healthcare. Its customers include large internet companies, government agencies, enterprises, and telecom operators, with a significant portion of revenue derived from overseas markets, especially in regions along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in China and overseas markets including Asia-Pacific (Singapore, Korea, Japan, Malaysia), North America (USA, Canada), Europe (UK, Ireland), and other regions such as Africa and Oceania. It maintains extensive edge node deployments worldwide and has established local teams and subsidiaries in key countries to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wangsu operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT infrastructure supply chain, providing network acceleration, edge computing, cloud security, and data center services. It acts as a service platform provider integrating computing, storage, and network resources, rather than manufacturing hardware components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company strategically focuses on enhancing its edge computing platform and security services, integrating AI capabilities, and expanding global market reach. R&D priorities include serverless architectures, AI-driven security, intelligent edge applications, and green data center technologies such as liquid cooling. It aims to deepen industry-specific solutions and strengthen overseas platform performance.
categories.revenue_model: Wangsu generates revenue mainly through service fees for CDN and edge computing, cloud security subscriptions, data center hosting and liquid cooling solutions, and sales of network and computing equipment. Revenue recognition is based on contract terms, including fixed monthly fees and usage-based billing, with income confirmed upon customer control transfer of services or products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading global IT infrastructure service provider with competitive advantages in CDN scale, edge computing innovation, and integrated security solutions. It competes with other CDN providers, cloud service companies, and network security firms domestically and internationally, leveraging its global network and technology depth to maintain a top-tier market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Wangsu reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.93 billion, a 4.81% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 674.5 million, up 10.02%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 12.09 billion, growing 10.24% from the previous year. Overseas revenue accounted for 57.66% of total revenue, reflecting strong international growth. R&D investment was RMB 447 million, about 9.07% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wangsu emphasizes delivering fast, stable, and secure IT infrastructure services globally, with a comprehensive edge computing platform that integrates computing, storage, network, and security at the network edge. Its unique value lies in its global intelligent service network, AI-enabled security solutions, and energy-efficient data center technologies, enabling customers to achieve superior digital and intelligent experiences with high reliability and performance.
